sentences.text: Shane Brandon McMahon -LRB- born January 15 , 1970 -RRB- is an American businessman and part-time professional wrestler who is a minority owner of WWE and the vice-chairman of Wecast Holdings Inc. .	professional wrestler	professional wrestler	WWE	WWE	vice-chairman	Chairman
He is currently the on-screen commissioner of WWE 's weekly television show SmackDown Live .	WWE	WWE	SmackDown Live	WWE SmackDown
McMahon is a fourth-generation wrestling promoter as a member of the McMahon family .	McMahon family	McMahon family
He began working in WWE at age 15 , starting in their warehouse , where he filled merchandise orders .	WWE	WWE
McMahon was also a referee , producer , announcer , and eventually a wrestler on-screen , while also becoming WWE 's Executive Vice President of Global Media behind the scenes .	WWE	WWE

He is the great-grandson of Roderick `` Jess '' McMahon , grandson of Vincent J. McMahon , son of WWE Owner/Chairman/CEO Vincent K. McMahon and former WWE CEO Linda McMahon , elder brother of WWE executive/personality Stephanie McMahon , and brother-in-law of WWE executive/wrestler Paul `` Triple H '' Levesque .	Linda McMahon	Linda McMahon	Stephanie McMahon	Stephanie McMahon	WWE	WWE	Vincent J. McMahon	Vince McMahon Sr.	Vincent K. McMahon	Vince McMahon

As a wrestler , he won the European Championship once and the Hardcore Championship once , and has wrestled in the main event of multiple WWE pay per views .	WWE	WWE	European Championship	WWE European Championship	once	List of WWE Hardcore Champions	Hardcore Championship	WWE Hardcore Championship
In 2009 , McMahon announced his resignation from WWE which went into effect January 1 , 2010 .	WWE	WWE
He later became CEO of entertainment service company YOU On Demand in late 2010 .

On July 12 , 2013 , McMahon voluntarily stepped down as CEO of YOU On Demand and appointed Weicheng Liu as his successor , while remaining the company 's principal executive officer and Vice Chairman of the Board .	principal executive officer	Executive officer
On February 22 , 2016 , he returned to the WWE as an on-screen character .	WWE	WWE
